item.title: Researcher Claims 6TB China LLM Router Logs Exposed Enterprise Credentials
item.description: Security researcher Chaofan Shou said he obtained about 6TB of invocation logs from a Chinese large-model relay and found SSH keys, cloud credentials and tokens tied to enterprises. The report is presented as a supply-chain risk claim pending confirmation.

item.title: LINXAI D30 Quadruped Carries 33kg to Top of Shenzhen Galaxy Twin Towers
item.description: LINXAI said its D30 mid-size quadruped climbed Shenzhen's Galaxy Twin Towers under a continuous 33kg load across 73 floors and more than 2,000 steps, framing the run as special inspection and emergency validation.

item.title: CIOE Shenzhen: AI Compute Tightens Optical Supply as 1.6T Modules Ramp
item.description: At CIOE 2026 in Shenzhen, exhibitors said AI cluster demand is stretching optical interconnect capacity: 800G remains the volume mainstay while 1.6T modules move into headmaker mass production amid tight upstream supply.

item.title: Doubao Work Adds Parallel Multi-Agents and Mac Local GUI Control
item.description: ByteDance's Doubao Work workplace agent now splits tasks across parallel sub-agents and extends Operate Computer screen-click control from Windows to Mac, without relying on APIs or MCP for coverage.

item.title: Unitree Opens UnifoLM-WLA-1.0 Humanoid Foundation Model Project Page
item.description: Unitree disclosed UnifoLM-WLA-1.0 on September 10, a ~6B embodied foundation model trained on about 2,500 hours of real-robot data that covers 64 tasks on one checkpoint. The project page is live, but code, weights and datasets remain Coming soon.
